# TPC-Havoc Q9_v3

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpchavoc
```

> [TPC-Havoc](../../tpc-havoc.md) benchmark · [all TPC-Havoc queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT nation, o_year, SUM(amount) AS sum_profit FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate) AS o_year, l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount) - ps.ps_supplycost * l.l_quantity AS amount FROM part AS p INNER JOIN lineitem AS l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey INNER JOIN supplier AS s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey INNER JOIN partsupp AS ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey AND p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey INNER JOIN orders AS o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey INNER JOIN nation AS n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE p.p_name LIKE '%green%') AS profit GROUP BY nation, o_year ORDER BY nation, o_year DESC
```
